standard.summary: 每个 DataLoader worker 的 PIL 解码 LRU
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The PIL decode LRU per DataLoader worker
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 每个 DataLoader worker 的 PIL 解码 LRU 容量。0 关闭缓存；缓存越大内存占用越高。

advanced_en.principle: PIL decode LRU capacity per DataLoader worker. 0 disables the cache; a bigger cache uses more memory.
